issuer.summary: Resilience (BVI) Ltd. issues senior unsecured limited-recourse tokens; Foundation acts as agent and InvSPC funds reinsurer notes. Administrative/tax expenses and agent fees precede senior payments. Holders have no direct title to cedant trust assets. Public original FY2025 SP1 audited financials add historical reserves, IBNR, loss development and named custodial accounts, but do not establish current attributable assets or first-loss capital.
issuer.summary_source: DA re-offchain-documentary/v1 original PPM/platform/TNF/SP1 reports, reviewed November7UTC; current runtime remains separate November6 Security evidence.
facts: Original Grant Thornton Attest (Cayman) LLP opinion dated June30,2026 covers SP1FY2025/restated2024, not current token issuer or InvSPC. Required supplementary information is omitted; material comparative restatements and control deficiencies disclosed.
Historical SP1 custody names Computershare, Truist and Wells Fargo, with collateral restrictions. Current trust deeds, balances, encumbrances and releases remain unavailable.
TNF October31,2025 snapshot signed December17,2025 includes gross premium receivables; excludes claims performance, collectibility, token backing and solvency assurance.
Public treaty rows improve issuer-disclosed visibility but lack independent current valuation/cedant identity and have missing/future fields. No current actuarial reserve opinion accepted.
Senior outranks mezzanine, but not administrative costs/taxes/agent fees. No direct trust-asset ownership or affiliate guarantee. Current contractually subordinate capital remains unknown.
Historical100m note programme and later aggregate offchain values have different dates/scopes; no present breach inferred.
BVI issuer licence remains unestablished; historical CIMA record and SP1audit concern separately regulated reinsurer. No clean incident-history claim renewed.
